description: A painterly night scene. A large four-engine cargo aircraft sits on a wet tarmac under floodlights, with a few figures and a forklift nearby. In the foreground an open wooden crate, stencilled with military-style markings, holds a bomb-like cylindrical munition in straw. On the left, a desk with a lamp, a candle and stacks of papers and ledgers feeds two shredders that spill paper strips into a bin.
reason: The wooden crate in the foreground has stencilled military-style lettering painted into its side and lid. The art should carry no painted text, so the crate markings need to be removed or redrawn without lettering.
